items.headline: US Proposes New Tariffs on 14 Nations, Shaking Global Financial Markets
items.summary: The United States proposed new trade tariffs targeting 14 major trading partners, including China and members of the European Union, to combat foreign industrial overcapacity. The sudden policy announcement sparked widespread volatility across global financial markets as investors weighed the risks to trade and economic growth.

items.headline: First Close-Up Images Reveal Aftermath of NASA Asteroid Deflection Mission
items.summary: The European Space Agency has released the first detailed photos of asteroid Dimorphos captured by its Hera spacecraft, revealing a massive crater left by NASA's 2022 impact experiment. The new images provide scientists with critical data to evaluate and refine future planetary defense systems against potential space threats.

items.headline: Lille Upset Bayern Munich 2-1 in UEFA Champions League Upset
items.summary: French club Lille delivered a major surprise by coming from behind to defeat Bayern Munich 2-1 in the UEFA Champions League league phase on Wednesday. The defeat handed the German powerhouse their first loss of the season and ended a 12-game winning streak across all competitions.

items.headline: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie Settle Years-Long Winery Lawsuit Out of Court
items.summary: Actors Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie released a joint statement announcing an out-of-court settlement in their contentious, multi-year legal battle over the French winery Château Miraval. The resolution officially ends the high-profile legal dispute that began in 2022 after Jolie sold her stake in the estate.
